# Lab Canary

> Free, open-source public scorecard tracking whether staff contracts and third-party evaluator agreements at major AI labs let people speak up about safety risks.

- Live site: https://labcanary.com/
- Evaluator contracts page: https://labcanary.com/#evaluators
- Source code & public evidence data (MIT / CC BY 4.0): https://github.com/johnny1011/labcanary
- Atom feed of rating updates: https://labcanary.com/feed.xml
- Raw criteria (JSON): https://labcanary.com/criteria.json
- Raw staff ratings (JSON): https://labcanary.com/ratings.json
- Raw evaluator ratings (JSON): https://labcanary.com/evaluators.json

## Labs covered
Anthropic, OpenAI, Google DeepMind, xAI, and Meta.

## Standard
Seven clauses for staff contracts (protect real secrets, never gag criticism or whistleblowing):
1. No secret NDAs
2. No gag on criticism
3. Equity is never hostage
4. Protected disclosures carved out
5. Whistleblowing policy is public
6. Safe internal channel
7. Secrets means secrets

Every rating links to a dated public source. Missing public evidence is marked "Not public" and earns zero points until the lab publishes its terms.
